title: Saves into a held, undrawn erase: lab imports and document saves do not pass applyInTurn's refusal
evidence: From the Codex re-check of PR 1599. ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/RecordStore+Uploads.swift importLabsInTurn (:31, engine.cloudLabImport) and saveDocumentInTurn (:80, engine.documentSave) call the cloud session directly, so they skip the refusal applyInTurn gives a record held with no drawing. Not reachable from the screen today: the upload button sits in My health's list (MyDataView.swift:309), which shows 'Your record did not load' while the record is held, and a review opened before the erase pinned the older screen (LabUploadSheet.swift:245, LabReviewView.swift:90), whose mark no longer holds, so shows(seen) refuses it. If one did run, the person would see 'saved'; the session keeps the values, and the screen draws the new record, which ends the held state, or stays on 'Your record did not load' if that draw fails too. A fix gives both paths the same refusal, with a test. US-25 AC16f | closed 2026-11-14 (lead S67's PR): no change, by design. US-25 AC16f says a record held with no drawing takes no edit through the store's edit path, but 'a lab report or document the person saves is still taken', and PR 1657 (S52) made importLabsInTurn and saveDocumentInTurn refuse on predatesErase only for that reason. Giving uploads applyInTurn's held refusal would contradict the accepted AC; a change needs the AC changed first (owner's call). The held test is now one named property, RecordStore.heldUndrawn (S67), if that ever changes.
